subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir bilhetes e cartas, em meio impresso e/ou digital, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar propósito comunicativo e público antes de produzir bilhete ou carta
components.description_en: Identify the communicative purpose and audience before producing a note or letter
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

components.description_pt: Planejar uma produção escrita considerando propósito e público-alvo antes do rascunho
components.description_en: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

components.description_pt: Produzir bilhete ou carta em forma impressa ou digital mantendo características do gênero
components.description_en: Produce a note or letter in print or digital form maintaining genre characteristics

components.description_pt: Aplicar formato apropriado de gêneros do cotidiano ao escrever mensagens ou cartas
components.description_en: Apply the appropriate format of everyday life genres when writing messages or letters
components.cc_component_description: Apply comma rules when writing greetings and closings of letters

cc_matches.description: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
Use commas in greetings and closings of letters.
